description_en: Upgrades the minor version of a PolarDB cluster
description_zh: PolarDB 边缘云集群小版本升级
name: UpgradeDBClusterVersionZonal

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade policy for the kernel version. Valid values:

HOT: hot upgrade

COLD: cold upgrade. This upgrade method is supported only for PolarDB for MySQL 8.0 clusters
parameters.help_zh:
内核版本升级策略。取值范围如下：

HOT：热升级

COLD：冷升级。目前仅PolarDB MySQL版8.0集群版支持该升级方式
parameters.name: upgrade_policy

parameters.help_en:
The label for the kernel version upgrade. Set the value to INNOVATE.

This parameter is applicable only when you upgrade a PolarDB for MySQL 8.0.1 cluster to PolarDB for MySQL 8.0.2.

If you specify this parameter, you must set `UpgradePolicy` to COLD
parameters.help_zh:
内核版本升级标签。取值固定为INNOVATE。

该参数仅适用于PolarDB MySQL版8.0.1版本升级至PolarDB MySQL版8.0.2版本。
当传入该参数时，`UpgradePolicy`必须传入COLD
parameters.name: upgrade_label

parameters.help_en:
The earliest time to start the scheduled kernel upgrade. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time is in UTC.

The start time can be any point in time within the next 24 hours. For example, if the current time is `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`, you can specify a time in the range of `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` to `2021-01-15T09:00:00Z`.

If you do not specify this parameter, the upgrade task is executed immediately
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行定时（即在目标时间段内执行）内核版本升级任务的最早时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
开始时间的取值范围为未来24小时内的任意时间点。例如当前时间为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`，此处允许填入的开始时间范围为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`~`2021-01-15T09:00:00Z`。
若该参数留空，默认立即执行内核版本升级任务
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The latest time to start the scheduled task. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time is in UTC.

The latest start time must be at least 30 minutes later than the earliest start time.

If you specify `PlannedStartTime` but not this parameter, the latest start time is 30 minutes after the value of `PlannedStartTime` by default. For example, if you set `PlannedStartTime` to `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` and leave this parameter empty, the task starts no later than `2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行目标定时任务的最晚时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
最晚时间需晚于开始时间的30分钟或以上。
若设置了`PlannedStartTime`但未指定该参数，执行目标任务的最晚时间默认为`开始时间+30分钟`。例如当设置`PlannedStartTime`为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`且该参数留空时，目标任务最晚将于`2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`开始执行
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately perform or schedule the kernel upgrade. Valid values:

false (default): Schedules the upgrade.

true: Immediately performs the upgrade.

You do not need to specify this parameter when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
立即执行或定时执行内核版本升级。取值范围如下：

false（默认值）：定时执行

true：立即执行

调用该接口时无需使用该参数
parameters.name: from_time_service

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade type. Valid values:

PROXY: Upgrades only the database proxy (PolarProxy).

DB: Upgrades only the kernel.

ALL (default): Upgrades both the database proxy (PolarProxy) and the kernel
parameters.help_zh:
升级类型。取值范围如下：

PROXY：仅升级数据库代理（Proxy）

DB：仅升级内核引擎

ALL（默认值）：同时升级数据库代理（Proxy）和内核引擎
parameters.name: upgrade_type

parameters.help_en: The version code of the target DB version. You can obtain this value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html operation
parameters.help_zh: DB目标版本的VersionCode，参数取值可从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html接口获取
parameters.name: target_db_revision_version_code

parameters.help_en: The version code of the target proxy version. You can obtain this value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html operation
parameters.help_zh: Proxy目标版本的VersionCode，参数取值可从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html接口获取
parameters.name: target_proxy_revision_version_code

parameters.help_en: A unique, case-sensitive token that you provide to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
